title: Huge cell text xlsx 001
notes: one giant cell A1 at the ECMA-376 cell-length maximum of 32,767 chars ('lorem ipsum ' repeated, truncated to exactly 32767), plus two short neighbour cells (B1, A2) that an extractor must still surface un-truncated next to the giant cell; 48k chars in one cell is impossible in a spec-valid xlsx (openpyxl truncates silently at 32767 — asserted here at exactly the max), so the reference text holds the full 32,767-char stored value; the fixture size IS the category, truncation-tolerance probe for string readers.
